cache_policy: delete each mode's TorchInductor cache at the start of every repetition; cold populates it and the immediately following warm launch reuses it
cold_definition: Fresh TorchInductor cache per mode/repetition; the shell wrapper, if used, also provides fresh VLLM_CACHE_ROOT and FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE per pair. HF model files, OS page cache, and CUDA driver cache are not cleared.
execution_order: repetition-major, then mode order, then cold followed by warm
